# Morocco Quest

> Morocco Quest is a licensed Moroccan travel agency based in Marrakech. We offer private Morocco tours, Sahara desert tours, small group tours, luxury desert camps, and tailor-made multi-day tour packages operated by expert local guides.

Morocco Quest (also known as Morocco Quest DMC) is based in Marrakech, Morocco. We operate in English, French, and Spanish and specialise in private Sahara desert tours, Marrakech-to-Merzouga journeys, Atlas Mountains trekking, Fes cultural tours, luxury riad stays, camel trekking, and Aït Benhaddou visits. All tours are led by licensed local guides. Contact us at +212-654-069-718.

Tour pages include departure city, duration, day-by-day itinerary and inclusions; prices are quoted on request. The site targets English-speaking travelers from the US, UK, France, Spain, and the EU.
